gen-gf-sniglet-gf-tenor-sans: Chunky, rod-like letters with a hushed, level beat in Sniglet, then Tenor Sans slips in with light, visible stroke variation and c tips that keep their distance. Over a long page it reads smoothly.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-tirra: Tirra rounds its forms like open parentheses, a sans-serif with a low, steady stroke that stays out of the way. And Sniglet is the one to make a statement, its single constant stroke width carrying the display punch.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-titillium-web: Sniglet draws everything with a constant stroke weight and no sparkle, which gives it its bold, quiet confidence. And Titillium Web, a sans-serif with stroke ends set far apart, brings the approachable, contemporary counterweight.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ysabeau: Approachable, first of all, thanks to Ysabeau's sweeping curves. Sniglet looks traced with one marker tip, and under it the plain sans body keeps a low, smooth stroke that carries a long read without snagging.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ysabeau-infant: Wiry, commanding display letters in Sniglet sit over Ysabeau Infant, whose terminals point outward like a pair of tongs. The wire-like line against the low-contrast sans is the draw.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ysabeau-sc: Professional, yet with a visibly gaping c at any size, Ysabeau SC leads the way. Sniglet's rod-built letters sit above it, and the sans-serif body's low contrast lets the heading's blunt shapes stand out.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Sniglet's strokes carry no hairlines and no shadows. Its blunt, uniform line against ZCOOL XiaoWei's smooth, modest weight gradient is what makes the pair work, the heading firm and the body gently shaded.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Sniglet's quiet, level beat, with terminals that stop before curling back in, gives the heading its distinct voice. Zen Kaku Gothic New keeps its open-mouthed curves clear, with no hairlines or swells, so a long passage flows smoothly.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Maru Gothic reads like following a single thread, never snagging on a closed-up bowl in its sans-serif form. But Sniglet is the pair's strongest card, a distinctive display heading with a level beat and no accents of weight.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-plein: Stencil-cut, tall and loud: Snowburst One has wide bridges between letters and an opening like a sprung paper clip. Plein follows with a clear channel leading into each round letter, a reliable, moderate-height body that grounds the display.
